message.content:
In Blackjack, an **Ace** is special because it can be counted as **either 1 or 11**, depending on which value gives your hand the best chance of winning without going over 21.

- **If counting the Ace as 11 keeps your total ≤ 21**, you’ll usually treat it as 11.  
- **If counting it as 11 would make you bust (> 21)**, you automatically treat it as 1.  

This flexibility creates “soft” hands (e.g., Ace‑6 = 17 or 7). If you’re dealt two Aces, one will normally count as 11 and the other as 1 (unless both as 1 keep you below 21). The goal is always to maximize your total while staying under 21.

We should answer: Ace can count as either 1 or 11, whichever benefits the hand without busting; if counting as 11 would cause bust, it counts as 1. Also mention that if you have two Aces, one counts as 11 and the other as 1 unless both counted as 1 to avoid bust. Also mention that Ace can be used as a soft hand. So answer accordingly.
